reviews.title: Not worth downloading. Wasted my time.
reviews.text: Asked me about a dozen questions about myself, then asked me for money, never accomplished anything guitar related but they did get some good user data survey questions from me. Hope my answers were helpful to the devs best of luck.

reviews.title: Bruh
reviews.text: At this point just use Garage Band, it’s way better than this, and there are so many more guitars you can chose from. On this app there’s only like 2 guitars I could choose from. There were ads everywhere. And why is anything that is free not good, like when I want a free app, I just want a free app, not something that you have to pay to basically use, there is always a premium, which I’m not saying is bad, I’m just saying, at least make the free plan good, instead of making almost everything in the app have to be used with the premium plan

reviews.title: bug
reviews.text: sometimes i’ll be playing then it just goes silent. i don’t write reviews often but someone needs to look into this
